## About
We started as a small fleet repair company, and we are still locally owned and family operated. Over the years the business has been built on customer service and on understanding how much it matters to keep your equipment on the road.
Today we are a full service truck shop. Repairs range from a quick lube to an engine overhaul, the body shop handles accident repair, painting and fabrication, and there are new and used Mitsubishi Fuso trucks for sale and for rent, plus a large selection of truck parts.
You will find us at 10831 Tukwila International Blvd in Tukwila.

## Services
- Diesel truck repair: Full service repair for all makes of diesel trucks, from quick lube to engine overhaul and everything in between.
- Body shop and paint: Accident repair, painting, fabrication and more, with a 60 foot paint booth that can take almost any piece of equipment.
- AC repairs: The shop handles AC repairs on trucks.
- New and used Mitsubishi Fuso trucks: As an authorized Mitsubishi Fuso dealer, the sales department offers new and used trucks along with bodies and accessories to fit what you need.
- Truck rentals: The truck rental department runs out of the main office with an all Mitsubishi Fuso fleet.
- Truck parts: A large selection of truck parts, including Mitsubishi Fuso parts.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on Mitsubishi Fuso trucks?
A: No. The shop repairs all makes of diesel trucks, and the technicians are Mitsubishi factory trained for Fuso work.

Q: What should I have ready when I ask for service?
A: It helps to know your truck's year, make and model and its complete VIN, whether you need an estimate, whether the truck needs pick up or towing, and when you need the work done.

Q: Do you sell truck bodies and lift gates?
A: Yes. We are an authorized dealer for Morgan Body Corporation boxes and Anthony lift gates.
